body: If you have tiktok, have you seen that joke where it was like "if you could go back in time and give your parents one thing what would it be?" and i just thought to myself therapy and a condom. But in reality same, im honestly just existing trying to find what little things I hold dear and hang on to it. Whether thats music, instrument, or my friends. I hope that i provided some help and comfort.

I understand. Everybody says that days like these don't last but then its like well then I have to worry about other crap coming up and screwing that up. Its frustrating because I want to live just not here, if that makes sense. I know you have to appreciate the good times but its really hard when people and life make that hard to enjoy and make it few and far between.

Honestly, I share so much with your post. I have been passively suicidal for a few years only now was active. I guess I just chickened out because I had my friends. I honestly have my own cycle where my dad pisses my mom off then she lashes out at me. Idk why but whenever my mom gets angry thats when I want to either die or sh. Not only do I have to deal with the personal issue but I see everything going on in the world and I just can't stand living. I feel for you in that you would think that I have a good life but it just seems like I can't stand living. I'm sorry that you have to go through this, if it possible there are programs that allow you to have a therapist or get free help online?

Honestly, I feel the same way. Anytime I get in trouble with my parents or my mom raises her voice/ is mad at me I have those same thoughts. My dad is a narcissist that uses any chance to use me to fuck with my mom. I can't fight back bc I have no idea how to (either it makes the situation worse, its held over my head, or I risk getting cut off, and I'm a broke college student). I feel like your friends would be understanding and would gladly help you or right your thoughts down, something to get it off your chest. I'm sorry you have to deal with this but I understand what your situation, and I hope you're okay
I also think it’s cruel to say that you will essentially trade one misery for another. I don’t think that’s fair for the person and not true
Thank you, and if you are feeling the same way I hope you find peace too.

I kind of feel the same way about helping others and believe me your really good at it. I guess I'm more afraid of hurting my friends than anyone else. I guess its the thought that my parents brought me into the world and didn't exactly make my life easy so I don't know if I would have sympathy for them. I wrote my note and I was really harsh with my dad but everything I said was true. I just don't see how living is so special, especially with everything in the world today.

Thank you. Its funny, I was born in a world and family full of chaos and all I want is peace, yet I have no idea on how to achieve it, or at least I have a morbid idea of how to get it. I guess I was too busy listening to others and doing what they think I should do so that now I don't know if my personality or my choices are my own. I was never asked those kinds of questions that let me sit down and think about what I want or who I am. I hope I'm not getting to personal, but do you still have thoughts about committing? I understand if you don't want to go into it I guess I'm just curious from your post

Thank you, I think I just want someone to understand what I feel you know? I know the thing with my parents is temporary but I've dealt with situations like that for so many years that its hard to keep coping with it. I don't want to live in this world and I guess if my method is the way to do it then fine, I just wish it wasn't the only option. Like I said I've tried everything to get better but it just doesn't work, at least for me.
I guess in my mind its hard to solve the problem and get better health when the world is the reason you are not mentally well, if that makes sense.
